title: DevX SDK docs - daily scratchpad & todo (sample apps, tutorials)
content:
Context:
- Quick scratchpad for SDK docs work today. Focus: close doc gaps for the JS + Python sample apps, fix tutorial step order, and update Quickstart for the new streaming API behavior.

Top priorities (today):
- [ ] Finalize sample-app repo README for JS (gh: sdk/examples/js-chat). broken instructions: auth, streaming example.
  - Current problem: streaming example in README references `client.streamChat({onDelta})` but SDK changed to `client.chat.stream()` in v0.9. Need code snippets and CLI snippet update.
  - Acceptance: README runs locally with env var instructions (REDWOOD_API_KEY), and example prints streaming deltas.
- [ ] Patch tutorial "Build a chat app" (docs/tutorials/chat.md) to reorder sections: auth -> install -> run (was install -> run -> auth - confuses users).
  - Add note about latency-first mode and recommended model variant for low-latency: `redwood/opt-llama-7b-qlora` (example config).
- [ ] Add missing examples for function calling usage in Python sample app (examples/python-echo).
  - Problem: snippet uses `response.functions` but new API uses `response.tools`. Update code and tests.

Smaller fixes / nice-to-haves:
- [ ] Update Quickstart to mention token accounting for streaming vs non-streaming. Small paragraph + a link to billing FAQ.
- [ ] Add short troubleshooting section in JS README: common errors (401, connection resets, CORS) + tl;dr fixes.
- [ ] Remove deprecated `createCompletion` references across docs (search repo).

Blocked / follow-ups:
- Blocked by API change confirmation from backend: is streaming method stable? (pinged @Devon Kim in #devx-sdk).
- Need design review for code sample UI screenshots (waiting on Samantha).

Notes / fragments:
- Local test steps for streaming example:
  1) export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...
  2) npm ci; node examples/js-chat/stream.js
  3) expect console.logs with partial text chunks

- Minimal JS streaming snippet (update before committing):
  const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
  const stream = await client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood/opt-llama-7b' });
  for await (const chunk of stream) { console.log(chunk.delta); }

- Jira to create for sample-app CI checks: RED-2143 (linked above) - add test that runs examples and validates exit code 0.

Questions to resolve:
- Should the sample apps pin the SDK major version in package.json or allow ^? My preference: pin to major.minor for reproducible examples (easier for users).
- Do we want to keep both `client.chat.stream()` and `client.streamChat()` as aliases for a release? if we don't, need a deprecation note.

Next steps (tomorrow):
- Merge README fixes -> small PRs: 1) js-readme, 2) python-funcs, 3) quickstart-billing-note.
- Add unit/integration test for streaming example in GH Actions (works w/ mock server).

Quick links for myself:
- SDK repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk
- Examples: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/tree/main/examples
- Devx channel: https://slack.redwood.com/archives/C01234567 (ping: @samantha)

Notes-to-self: keep comments light in sample README; prefer `npx` runnable commands; add a one-line tl;dr at top of each README.

-- isabel
